title: Binding conflict
description: A binding that names no account because the account it would name is not this subject's alone to have (registry BINDING_CONFLICT). One shape wherever it travels: an apply or plan outcome's conflict, a BINDING_CONFLICT problem's extension member, and an entry of GET /subjects' conflicts. The holder (username and account_id, or holders) is never the subject's account, and is never acted on for the subject.

reason.description: name_held: another account holds the name (the derived one, or the one the binding is recorded under). number_held: the recorded name is gone and the recorded number, one the app can hand out again, is held by another name. ambiguous: two or more accounts hold the key the binding is looked up by, so none is named (holders lists them). claimed_twice: another subject's binding names the same account, so neither is given it (the holder is that account; bound_to the other subject when there is one).

username.description: The holder's name. Every reason but ambiguous.

account_id.description: The holder's account_id, in the same read. Every reason but ambiguous.

holders.description: ambiguous only: every account that holds the key, none of them named.

adoptable.description: account.adopt would bind the holder to this subject as things stand: no other subject holds it, it is not the add-on's own, and this subject has no binding. Never true for ambiguous or claimed_twice.

bound_to.description: The subject the holder is bound to, when one is.

detail.description: What the conflict is, as a sentence for an operator, in the add-on's words.

next.description: What the operator does next, as a sentence.
